hero.description: Billet train near Celsa steelworks. A train carrying billets of steel makes its way from Celsa Steelworks to Castle Works, one of several such trains to run each day. The locomotive is No. DH50-2, built by Hunslet.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland
May 2015 in rail transport in Cardiff
